rules.text: "componentTag" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting section | div | article | aside | header | footer | nav | main. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.
